title: Cross-Chain Arbitrage Hunter
description: A whale bridged assets from ETH to BSC, bought a token 5 minutes before a major listing announcement.

events.description: Whale bridges 50 ETH from Ethereum to BSC
Converts ETH to BNB on BSC
Buys 200 BNB of CAKE within 5 minutes

agent_reasoning.reasoning: 50 ETH bridged to BSC. Unusual: no DEX activity on ETH side. Pure cross-chain play.
200 BNB into CAKE within 5 min of bridge completion. Extremely aggressive timing.
Partnership announcement validates the move. Insider timing suspected but unproven.
Too perfect timing. Either insider or incredibly lucky. Suspicious.

stages.name: Deliberation
stages.trigger_reason: Spread > 30% between Token Analyst (80%) and Social B (45%)

challenges.challenge: Bridge-to-buy timing is suspicious but the profit is real. Focus on outcomes.
Promoting insider trading as alpha? Ethics matter.

responses.response: Not promoting. Analyzing. The pattern exists regardless of ethics. Adjusting to 76%.
Fair distinction. Adjusting to 50%. Still flagging risk.

stages.ruling: Cross-chain pattern is legitimate alpha signal. Timing correlation is high. Ethical concerns noted but separate from analysis. Final: 78.5%

stages.name: Report Generation
stages.conclusion: Cross-chain Hunter pattern confirmed. Whale used bridge mechanics to position before announcement. High probability of informed trading. Pattern: Cross-Chain Hunter + Sniper hybrid.
